contexts: 40 of 212 pharmacies proposed for extended hours
reading: The budget question and the practice question meet at the counterfactual: what late-night users would have done without the pharmacy. Budget figures depend on it and it is estimated, not observed. Staffing costs and lone working determine whether the service lasts. Access for shift workers and people without a registered GP is the main equity case, and demand moving from daytime services is the main threat to savings.
